note: 26 Oct 2026 - 'Is Your Partner A Dream BUILDER or A Dream STEALER?' (Rumble v6qzmik). Weekly agent.

clips.caption:
Ray Kroc's first wife wasn't his cheerleader - she wanted him to quit chasing McDonald's and live a normal, safe life.

He kept building anyway, then watched young couples running McDonald's franchises side by side, building each other up instead of tearing each other down.

So he divorced her and married a woman who worked in the stores, made the hamburgers, and helped shape the whole brand.

Kevin Trudeau's point: two horses pulling together don't move twice the weight - they move three times the weight.

Who's actually pulling the wagon with you?

#kevintrudeau #raykroc #mcdonalds #relationshipgoals #entrepreneurmindset #successmindset

clips.end_words: your spouse makes a huge difference
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau puts it on you directly: are you building your partner's dream, or quietly stealing it?

Men, do you talk your wife up when she's not even in the room? Women, are you actually behind your husband, or just living next to him?

He says support from a brother, a parent, a best friend all matters - but none of it compares to support from the person you share a bed with. That one relationship can make or break everything else you're chasing.

If your partner has a dream right now, you're either helping build it or you're in the way.

Which one have you actually been this year?
